name: bestari
description: Community App Bestari - KWT Sorgum (backend + frontend dalam satu perintah)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c green,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
